paper_id: Chu et al. - 2010 - Versatile Stack Management for Multitasking Sensor Networks
title: Versatile Stack Management for Multitasking Sensor Networks
motivation: 传统栈管理技术在资源受限的传感器网络上 multitasking 能力严重受限
problem_framing: 在小内存平台上如何高效管理多任务栈以实现灵活的 preemptive multitasking
key_insight: 在 base station 端进行完整 binary translation 而非 on-node rewrite，使代码高度优化并迁移计算开销
method_signature: Base station binary rewriting + logical address translation + automatic stack relocation
evaluation_criteria: 代码膨胀率、执行时间开销、CPU 利用率、最大可调度任务数、栈重定位次数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 适用于 CPU 利用率低于 30% 的应用；内存地址翻译开销较高；间接分支高开销
evidence_for_taste: None of these facts are true in low-power computing
appears to be a heavyweight solution, but the cost is, in fact, surprisingly low
CPU cycles are, however, usually not a bottleneck
we feel confidently that occasional sub-millisecond delays ... is a small and welcomed cost
thinking_moves: 识别 fundamental limitation: textbook solution 的三个假设在低功耗系统均不成立
引入新术语 'stack versatility' 重新 frame 问题域
挑战常识: heavy 看起来的 solution 在小内存系统成本意外低
计算迁移: 将重开销转移到有充裕资源的 base station
co-design: binary rewriting 与 kernel runtime 协同设计而非独立优化
